specs.title: stem-bot-v2 README - API Specification & System Overview
specs.description: Primary specification document for the Discord Bot API server. Covers system overview, all REST API endpoints (roles sync, nickname management, generation role creation, member status), request/response schemas, authentication (Bearer token), database structure (5 tables in member schema), environment variables, deployment, and security considerations.
sections: 概要 (Overview) - Express + Discord.js + Supabase bot API server for Discord member management automation
機能 (Features) - Role sync, nickname management, generation role creation, member status check
API仕様 (API Specification) - 6 endpoints: POST /api/roles/sync, GET /api/nickname, POST /api/nickname/update, POST /api/generation, GET /api/member/status, GET /health
エラーレスポンス (Error Response) - JSON error format with conditional details field
データベース構造 (Database Structure) - 5 tables: members, teams, member_team_relations, team_leaders, generation_roles
セキュリティ (Security) - Bearer token auth, env-based token management, error info suppression in production

specs.title: Database Schema Definition (table.sql)
specs.description: PostgreSQL DDL for the member schema. Defines 5 tables: member.members (with FK to auth.users, status/generation/student_number/discord_uid/is_admin fields), member.teams, member.member_team_relations (M:N), member.team_leaders, member.generation_roles. Includes indexes and foreign key constraints with CASCADE delete/update.
sections: member.members - Core member table with supabase_auth_user_id PK, status INTEGER, generation INTEGER, student_number TEXT, discord_uid TEXT UNIQUE, is_admin BOOLEAN
member.teams - Team table with UUID PK, name TEXT, discord_role_id TEXT
member.member_team_relations - Many-to-many member-team junction table
member.team_leaders - Team leader assignments (composite PK)
member.generation_roles - Generation-to-Discord-role mapping (generation INTEGER PK)
Indexes - On status, discord_uid, is_admin, discord_role_id, foreign keys

specs.title: TypeScript API Type Definitions
specs.description: TypeScript interface definitions for all API request/response types. Covers RolesSyncRequest/Response, NicknameResponse, NicknameUpdateRequest/Response, GenerationCreateRequest/Response, MemberStatusResponse, RoleAssignRequest/Response, RoleRemoveRequest/Response, DiscordRoleListResponse, and ErrorResponse. Reveals additional endpoints not in README: POST /api/roles/assign, POST /api/roles/remove, GET /api/roles/discord-list.
sections: RolesSync - sync discord roles based on DB member data
Nickname - get/update nickname with formatting rules
Generation - create generation role in Discord + DB
MemberStatus - check Discord server membership
RoleAssign/Remove - direct role assignment/removal by discord_role_id (not in README)
DiscordRoleList - list all Discord server roles (not in README)
ErrorResponse - standard error format

specs.title: TypeScript Database Type Definitions
specs.description: TypeScript interface definitions mapping to the PostgreSQL member schema tables: Member, Team, MemberTeamRelation, TeamLeader, GenerationRole. Provides the application-level data model for all database entities.
sections: Member - supabase_auth_user_id, status, generation, student_number, discord_uid, avatar_url, is_admin, joined_at, deleted_at
Team - id, name, discord_role_id
MemberTeamRelation - member_id, team_id
TeamLeader - team_id, member_id
GenerationRole - generation, discord_role_id

specs.title: Express Server Entry Point & Route Definitions
specs.description: Express application setup with CORS configuration, route registration, and server startup. Defines the complete route map: 10 authenticated endpoints + 1 unauthenticated health check. Reveals CORS wildcard default when ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset, Discord bot login flow, Supabase keepalive mechanism, and middleware chain (cors → json → auth → routes → 404 → errorHandler).
sections: CORS Configuration - wildcard default, configurable via ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var

Route Map - POST /api/roles/sync, POST /api/roles/sync-all, POST /api/roles/assign, POST /api/roles/remove, GET /api/roles/discord-list, GET /api/nickname, POST /api/nickname/update, POST /api/generation, GET /api/member/status, GET /api/members
Health Check - GET /health (unauthenticated), returns Discord WS status, bot user, guild accessibility
Startup Flow - Discord bot login → Supabase keepalive → Express listen
Middleware Chain - cors → express.json → authMiddleware (per-route) → errorHandler

specs.title: Authentication Middleware Specification
specs.description: Bearer token authentication middleware implementation. Extracts token from Authorization header, compares against API_AUTH_TOKEN env var using simple string equality (not timing-safe). Returns 401 on missing/invalid token, 500 if API_AUTH_TOKEN is unset. Logs invalid token attempts with client IP.
sections: Token Extraction - Bearer prefix check, substring(7) extraction
Token Validation - Direct string equality comparison (token !== validToken), NOT timing-safe
Error Handling - 401 for missing/invalid token, 500 for missing server config
Logging - Warns on invalid token attempts with req.ip

specs.title: Docker Deployment Configuration
specs.description: Docker Compose deployment configuration. Single service 'bot' exposing port 3000, loading .env file, production NODE_ENV, restart unless-stopped policy.
sections: Service: bot - port 3000, .env, NODE_ENV=production, restart unless-stopped

specs.title: Debug SQL Query Collection
specs.description: Collection of diagnostic SQL queries for the member schema. Includes table row counts, member lookups by discord_uid, team membership queries, leader status checks, generation role listings, complete member info CTE query, and data integrity checks. Reveals query patterns and expected data relationships used by the application.
sections: Table counts - all 5 member schema tables
Member queries - by discord_uid, with team/leader/generation joins
Data integrity checks - orphaned foreign key detection
Test data templates - commented INSERT examples for teams, generation roles

notes: No external specification URLs found - this is an internal Discord bot project
README.md serves as primary API specification (Japanese language)
API type definitions reveal 3 additional endpoints not documented in README: /api/roles/assign, /api/roles/remove, /api/roles/discord-list, /api/roles/sync-all, /api/members
Auth middleware uses non-timing-safe string comparison (security concern)
CORS defaults to wildcard when ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset
Health endpoint is unauthenticated and leaks Discord bot metadata (guild ID, WS status, bot user tag)
